use_cases: Showcasing portfolio projects with scroll-triggered card stacking animations
Displaying sequential content like timelines or milestones with parallax card effects
Creating immersive scroll-driven storytelling experiences for landing pages
Building project galleries with smooth lenis-based scroll and scale transformations
Designing interactive timelines with motion-powered card reveals
ai_summary: A scroll-driven stacking card component that creates an immersive portfolio-style experience where cards scale and stack as users scroll. Features smooth Lenis scrolling, motion-based transforms for image scaling and card progression, and minimalist dark styling. Designed for showcasing sequential content like projects, timelines, or creative work with cinematic scroll-triggered animations.
